name: behavior-implementer
description: [tien-os] Implements features scenario-first: Given/When/Then scenarios seen failing, the three laws of TDD, and a measured quality gate before every commit.

interface.shortDescription: [tien-os] Implement features scenario-first with BDD/TDD discipline.
interface.longDescription: A dual-host agent plugin that implements features behavior-first: natural-language Given/When/Then scenarios written before any code, every scenario seen failing before it may pass, the three laws of TDD during implementation, and a measured coverage/lint/complexity gate before every commit. It never pushes without asking.
